transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Sana. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am beyond frustrated! My phone has been dropping calls every five minutes and the screen is flickering constantly. This is ridiculous!
Agent: I need your account number and date of birth to access your records.
Customer: My account number is 44083287 and my date of birth is 16/01/1996. My name is Michael Iyer.
Agent: The account is verified. What is the phone number associated with the account?
Customer: It is 94562 38486.
Agent: I am checking the network status in your area. There are no reported outages, so the issue is likely with your device or the SIM card.
Customer: I don't care whose fault it is, I just want it to work! I've been trying to fix this for hours.
Agent: I will send a replacement SIM card to your address on file.
Customer: Okay, that handles the SIM, but what about the network drops and the flickering screen?
Agent: I am raising a network ticket to investigate the signal strength at your location.
Customer: Thank you so much, Sana. I really appreciate you getting this sorted for me.
